name.text: Bright Horizons Canada Square Day Nursery and Preschool

data.street_address: 20 Canada Square, Canary Wharf, London, E14 4DA

description.text:
Part of the Bright Horizons family, Canada Square Day Nursery and Preschool (formerly Little Unicorns) offers large, spacious rooms, each tailored to the different age groups of the children. The nursery also boasts a large play room and a library.

The nursery offers a wide variety of engaging activities, which encourage children to learn and explore in a home from home environment. Children are well-prepared for the transition to school with the unique Bright Horizons Ready for School Programmes, including Growing Readers, Writers and Mathematicians.

Canada Square Nursery has drop off and pick up areas above the nursery entrance and is located at the east end of Canary Wharf. It is easily accessible from the DLR and Jubilee Line stations.

The team of enthusiastic childcare professionals were happy to achieve a 'Good' rating by Ofsted in June 2013. Bright Horizons portfolio was proud to receive the Royal Society for the Prevention of Accidents (ROSPA) award in April 2016.

Location: Canada Place
